body.name: equal-propensity normalized \(L_1\) subexperiment
body.construction: For \((\mathbf P,\mathbf Q)\in\Delta_d^2\), set \(q_{11,x}=q_{00,x}=P_x/4\) and \(q_{10,x}=q_{01,x}=Q_x/4\), and complete the observed law with conditionally independent Bernoulli potential outcomes, treatment propensity \(1/2\), and consistency.
